reviews.author: Nick Hare
reviews.text:
I used Lauras Mebeles for a new kitchen in an apartment refurbishment

I found both workers and Management of Lauras Mebeles friendly and professional

I found the whole process from: initial enquiry, measurements and consultation with our builder, design and material choice to final fitting, ran professionally and efficiently

reviews.author: Dávid Sauce
reviews.text:
Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We are extremely happy with our beautiful new kitchen made by Lauras Mēbeles!

The team travelled all the way from Latvia to Hungary in just one day, and in only two days they created and installed this absolutely stunning kitchen.

Their professionalism, precision, attention to detail, and dedication to their work were truly impressive. Everything was done with great care, accuracy, and excellent craftsmanship.

The result exceeded our expectations, and we couldn’t be happier with our new kitchen!

A huge thank you to the entire team at Lauras Mēbeles for their amazing work. We highly recommend them to anyone looking for beautiful, high-quality custom-made furniture!

Thank you for making our dream kitchen a reality! ❤️
